mapper.sql: o.id, o.return_no AS returnNo, o.erp_tenant_id AS erpTenantId, t.tenant_name AS ownerName, t.parent_wms_tenant_id AS operatorId, op.tenant_name AS operatorName, o.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, GREATEST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_return_qc_item ri WHERE ri.return_order_id = o.id), 1) AS skuKinds, o.total_quantity AS totalQty, o.return_status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM wms_return_inbound_order o LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = o.erp_tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant op ON op.id = t.parent_wms_tenant_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
